en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an urban scene with women washing clothes at an outdoor wash-house along a canal or water trough, bordered by stone posts. Behind them rise several multi‑story residential buildings with balconies, hanging laundry, and tiled roofs. To the right is a high wall and an open paved area. The postcard has printed captions at the bottom identifying the scene and location, plus handwritten notes in Italian both across the lower margin and along the right side.
